events.notes:
SAIV110 / OSU107 firmware 0.9.9Q
Hardware: OSU-M 3.1.2
Release date: 2026-09-07

Changes from 0.9.9P to 0.9.9Q
---------------------------
- Set the logger's local date and time with X in the OSU107 and Surface menus.
  Input is echoed, Backspace is supported, and invalid dates are rejected.
  After setting the time, choose the LT/GMT label without shifting that time.
  Stop logging before changing the clock.
- Numeric input is now echoed in the external instrument's oxygen calibration
  C menu and coefficient-entry M menu. Self-test T displays progress while
  waiting for the instrument to finish.
- In OSU107 mode, U can apply saved configuration even when the external
  instrument is asleep or absent. Stop logging before applying configuration.
  The resulting product mode determines which menu is shown.
- Configuration is rejected if Surface and Instrument are both enabled.
  Select one mode; both disabled is also allowed. A rejected change leaves
  the active configuration unchanged.

Earlier changes: 0.9.9P (2026-09-03)
----------------------------------
- Improved automatic air-pressure setting after an external Mag-Key start.
- Prevented range changes and retained measurement sessions from incorrectly
  starting another automatic air-pressure sequence.
- Improved instrument UART framing and handling of stale measurement data.
- Improved shared USB-disk access and showed LT/GMT in startup clock status.

Earlier changes: 0.9.9O (2026-08-30)
----------------------------------
- Kept the COM interface available while the logger owns the storage disk.
  Use F after stopping measurements to make the disk available to the PC.
- Improved USB reconnection after disk refresh and preserved output columns
  with nan placeholders when enabled sensors fail.

Updating
--------
Use the firmware updater's Check firmware function and review the detected
device, hardware and offered version before selecting Update device.
Keep USB and power connected until the updater has finished and verified
the running version. Use only the BIN for the stated hardware revision.
Back up configuration and calibration before an update. Review the updater's
configuration-restoration instructions before returning the unit to service.
After programming, config/system.ini must be regenerated to show the running
software version: delete only that file, then reboot through Ctrl+T, SLP, RESET.
Retain the other configuration files, including calibration. Verify the running
firmware and the regenerated system.ini version, serial number and settings.
If verification fails, retain the backup and inspect the device before retrying.
